title: ആയുർവേദത്തിലെ നേത്രരോഗ ചികിത്സ| The Science Brigade
tags: Ayurvedic remedies to improve failing eyesight
description:
Kannil Podi Idunna Ayurvedam
Recently there were news in the media that the eye sight of the Ex Kenyan President Raila Odinga’s daughter, Rosemary Odinga’s eye sight was restored through Ayurveda treatment. This is a live recording of the discussion in Malayalam on the same topic which was conducted by The Science Brigade on Fri, 18th March 2022 in Clubhouse. This discussion shows what is actually written in Ayurveda texts with regards to diseases of the eye and its treatment. The discussion also explain how the eye works in detail using simple language and looks at some poor quality studies that Ayurveda practioners have conducted over the years. 
This recording is made public after receiving permission from the speakers and TSB. This recording is in Malayalam 
Attended by Nishad Kaippally, Tony Philip, Dr Nandakumar, Dr Cyriac Abby Philips, Dr Ijas, Dr Shinsmon, Dr Libin Abraham, Dr mathew Philips, Haneesh Mohanan, Anupa, Roshan, Rakesh Unnikrishnan and Sanathanan
